  "text": "Ada clamped the ledger shut. The pressure beneath its cover kept moving, as if a finger were writing on the inside.

“Don’t let whom?” Elias asked.

In the cellar, Venn braced his free hand against the wall. His mouth opened in a silent cry. The constable stepped toward the yellow door, and Venn’s trapped wrist twisted sharply downward.

“Stop,” Ada said.

The constable stopped. So did the movement in the wall.

Mara held her match closer to his face. In its light, Ada saw a thin black line circling his left wrist. It looked like ink, except that it tightened when he glanced at Venn.

“I haven’t touched him,” he said.

“No,” Ada answered. “But something came here with you.”

She opened the ledger to the last page. Beneath the warning, fresh letters rose through the paper: ASK HIM WHICH DOOR.

Elias swallowed. “I already did.”

“Ask him again.”

The constable looked from the passage behind them to the cellar ahead. For a moment his uneven heel tapped against the stone, though he stood still.

“Which door?” Elias asked.

“The one I came through,” the constable said. “The one you sealed.”

From behind the wall came two quick knocks and one slow. Venn heard them too. He turned his head, staring not at Ada but at the sealed stone behind her.

The yellow door began to close. Ada caught its edge with her boot. Across the ledger’s blank page, one final word appeared, pressed so deep it tore the paper:

RUN."
